title: Entity registry
description: The canonical record of who exists: supervisory unions, member districts, schools and towns, with relationships and effective dates. Bitemporal-lite: when Act 170 mergers take effect the old entities do not disappear, they close, and their history stays queryable. One file per entity type, records sorted by slug, so a nightly sync produces readable per-record diffs.

snapshot.description: Path to the raw API response this sync was built from, under registry/raw/YYYY-MM-DD/.

slug.description: Our stable internal ID. Assigned once and never changed, even when AOE renames or renumbers the entity.

aoe_server_id.description: The API's internal ServerId. Recorded for cross-referencing but never used as a key -- it is an implementation detail of their system.

effective_from.description: When this entity began. The AOE API publishes no opening date, so for entities first seen through the sync this is the date of the snapshot that first observed them, and `effective_from_basis` says so. Do not read it as an authoritative founding date.

effective_to.description: When this entity closed, from the CloseDate field on the AOE closed_organizations endpoint. Null means currently active.

successor.description: Slug of the entity that took over this one's territory or students. The AOE API publishes NO successor field -- every value here is hand-entered from statute or AOE guidance and must carry a note. This is the lineage the 2028-29 consolidation work depends on.

supervisory_union.description: Slug of the SU this entity belongs to.

operated_by.description: Slug of the district that operates this entity. NOTE: the AOE API's ParentOrg/OperatedBy fields carry inverted meanings between towns and schools -- for a town, ParentOrg is its union district and OperatedBy is its SU; for a school, ParentOrg is its SU and OperatedBy is its district. The sync untangles this; do not read the raw fields directly.

reporting_only.description: True for AOE reporting buckets rather than real organizations -- a town record named UNKNOWN is how residency is recorded for pupils whose town is not established. These are kept because other records reference them, but no average daily membership is awarded to them: they contribute no weighted pupils, owe no budget in the coverage matrix, and cannot take part in a merger scenario. Recording it here keeps the constraint in the data rather than in the memory of whoever writes the next query.

member_towns.description: Slugs of towns whose students this district serves. Populated for districts, empty for other types.

grade_span.description: Normalized integer form of `grades`, for schools. PK and EE map to -1, K to 0, grades 1-12 to themselves. The integer form exists so 'the nearest school of the same grade span' is a comparison rather than a string match; `grades` is kept verbatim beside it per the stated-versus-computed principle.

grade_span_class.description: Derived from grade_span. Selects the travel-time threshold in the small/sparse framework, which proposes 45 minutes one way for elementary pupils and 60 for grades 7-12. A span crossing that boundary -- K-8 and K-12, of which Vermont has many -- is ambiguous under the framework as drafted; the engine applies the stricter threshold and flags it rather than choosing the convenient one.

mailing_city.description: MailingCity as AOE publishes it. A POSTAL designation and not a municipality: Vermont post office names routinely cover parts of several towns. Recorded because it is what the source says, and never read as `municipality`.

municipality.description: Slug of the town, city or gore the school BUILDING stands in. Load-bearing for the sparse screen, which tests the density of the municipality where the school is located rather than of the district's member towns -- a school in a dense town inside an otherwise sparse district does not pass it. Null until established; the screen then declines to evaluate rather than guessing.

municipality_basis.description: How `municipality` was established. `aoe_mailing_city` is recorded but is NOT sufficient for the density screen, because a postal city is not a municipality; the screen treats it as unestablished. `census_geocoder_point_in_polygon` resolves the published coordinates against Census county subdivisions and is sufficient.

geocode_precision.description: Precision of latitude/longitude. `municipality_centroid` is not good enough to screen a 10-to-15-mile distance threshold, so the distance criterion returns indeterminate at that precision instead of estimating.

school_type.description: Only public schools are eligible for the Act 73 small and sparse support grants. Independent schools stay in the registry because they are receiving schools in consolidation scenarios and appear in the tuitioning limb of the necessity criteria.

aoe_published.description: What AOE publishes for each field currently under correction, kept alongside the corrected value rather than reconciled with it. Absent entirely -- never an empty object -- when no correction is in force for this entity. A field leaves this map the moment AOE adopts the correction. Written by the sync from registry/corrections.yaml; do not hand-edit.

manual_overrides.description: GENERATED from registry/corrections.yaml by the sync -- do not hand-edit. One entry per correction currently in force, with the evidence summarized in `reason`. Entries disappear when AOE adopts the correction.
